settings.title: Theme
settings.description: The stylesheet the window is drawn with.

settings.title: Light or dark
settings.description: Which half of a color pair the theme is read as
settings.details: Which half of a color pair the theme is read as. A theme that declares light and dark itself leaves this nothing to choose.

settings.title: Interface size
settings.description: Scale of controls and interface text. 1 is the default.

settings.title: Reading size
settings.description: Scale of book and document text. 1 is the default.

settings.title: Font size
settings.description: Size of editor text in px, whatever the interface size.

settings.title: Font family
settings.description: Choose a preset or enter an installed font family.

settings.title: Line height
settings.description: Height of a line of editor text as a multiple of the font size.

settings.title: Line numbers
settings.description: Number the lines in editors.

settings.title: Highlight active line
settings.description: Highlight the line containing the caret.

settings.title: Soft wrap
settings.description: Wrap long lines in editors instead of scrolling sideways.

settings.title: Sync title and filename
settings.description: Renaming one also renames the other.

settings.title: Performance profile
settings.description: How much of the hardware indexing and models may use.

options.title: Eco
options.detail: One thread and a quarter of the memory, at the lowest priority.

options.title: Low
options.detail: A quarter of the performance cores and a quarter of the memory.

options.title: Balanced
options.detail: Half of the performance cores and half of the memory.

options.title: High
options.detail: Three quarters of the performance cores and of the memory.

options.title: Maximum
options.detail: All performance cores and 90% of the memory.

settings.title: Reranking
settings.description: Services that order the results of a query, tried in order
settings.details: Services that order the results of a query with a rerank stage by relevance, tried in order until one answers. With an OpenRouter key, add an OpenRouter connection and choose the model mongodb/rerank-3: it ranks best and answers in a few seconds. Without one, the Local reranker, which runs on this machine and takes tens of seconds for each run, is used while no service is chosen here; choosing a service replaces it.

settings.title: Rerank window
settings.description: Documents a rerank stage orders when the query names no window

settings.title: Most reranked passages
settings.description: Most passages one rerank stage sends to the reranking service

settings.title: Longest reranked text
settings.description: Most bytes of one passage sent to the reranking service

settings.title: Default results
settings.description: Results a query returns when it names no limit

settings.title: Most results
settings.description: Most results one query returns

settings.title: Passages per condition
settings.description: Passages the index returns for each meaning and words condition

settings.title: Most passages scored
settings.description: Most passages the query is applied to

settings.title: Most folders
settings.description: Most path.startsWith conditions one query joins

settings.title: Merge gap
settings.description: Largest gap in bytes between passages of one file that join

settings.title: Log level
settings.description: Which entries are written to the application log.

settings.title: Longest query
settings.description: Most bytes of the text of one query
